package.name: direct_odom
package.description: Standalone wheel-odom + IMU-orientation dead-reckoning node (/direct_odom), built for A/B comparison against the robot_localization EKF (/odometry/filtered). Does not depend on or modify robot_localization, rmd_x8_driver, or myahrs_driver, and can run alongside reduced_odom_bringup.launch.py without conflict.
